svg.title: IMG-03-02 Scanner fields of the front scanner, top view
svg.desc: Owner sketch 2026-11-15. Warning field 1 1200 x 1300 C300, warning field 2 800 x 1100 C200, protective field semicircle R400, measured from the scanner origin 70 mm behind the vehicle front face (owner). Vehicle: CAD top view IMG-04-01, panel buttons corrected.
svg.text: Protective field: semicircle R 400. Safety stop, motor power cut
Warning field 2: 800 long × 1100 wide, corners C200. Controlled stop
Warning field 1: 1200 long × 1300 wide, corners C300. Automatic speed halved
Dimensions in mm, measured from the scanner, 70 mm behind the front of the vehicle. Fields centred on the vehicle centreline.
